faq.q: How do I install Pou on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Pou and check the developer is Zakeh before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Zakeh and may be altered, so the safest way to play Pou is the official listing.

faq.q: How do I get coins in Pou?
faq.a: Play the mini-games in the Game Room. Coins also come from levelling up. You can buy coins, but regular play is enough for food and most items.
Pou is rated Everyone and is easy to play. Parents should know it shows ads and sells coins, so turn on purchase authentication in Google Play.
